implementation: Two SDK lossless SamplingMonitors freeze complete input and all registered output channels synchronously at DriveStable/RisingEdge. After paired event/tick/channel validation the environment publishes all decoder views together; it does not advance protocol models in capture callbacks.

Old EdgeMonitor names are only decoder/non-consuming cache views, not a second subscription or hand-written clock loop. CycleSnapshot is frozen and nested mappings are detached/read-only; mutable dataclasses or native views are rejected.

Execution.paused keeps subscriptions active but prevents idle pytest task switches from inventing ready/fire edges. Large waits are delivered in bounded chunks with every cycle retained and checked for tick continuity.

Closed phase observers, deleted/replaced registered channels, replayed events and cancellation after edge but before delivery leave sticky sampling failures. Normal fixture exit audits sampling, and live preview APIs cannot substitute for a vanished observer.

evidence_boundary.limit: Sampling/checkpoint integrity is not complete protocol checking. ResolveQueue/Ftq still need SDK driver and full schema ownership, input UID/merge/age/retry/cancel semantics and bounded transaction finish. Existing live combinational previews remain phase-explicit observations, not acceptance evidence. Native merged artifacts do not imply coverage closure; raw coverage inputs are not retained.

collection.verdict_boundary: Collection-only mixed full inventory includes internal VAGQ, not unified-public hardware acceptance. CLI exit1 remains the registered IFU residual gate, not a collection failure.
